GIG DELIVERY PARTNER SERVI-
CES AGREE-
MENT

THIS INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR AGREE-
MENT is executed between FastDrop Logistics Pvt Ltd and the Delivery Partner.

1. DEACTIVATION AND TERMI-
NATION
Company reserves unilateral authority to suspend, deactivate, or perma-
nently block Partner account without prior written notice if customer rating falls below 4.2 stars or upon unverified allegation of delay.

2. LIABIL-
ITY AND INDEMNITY
Partner shall indem-
nify, defend, and hold harmless Company, its directors, and affiliates from all third-party claims, property losses, fines, or damages arising directly or indirectly during delivery shifts.
